chunks: He said: And al-Rida (peace be upon him) said, regarding the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'So overlook with gracious forgiveness' [15:85]. He said: Forgiveness without reproach.

key_terms.الصفح الجميل: Gracious forgiveness — a Quranic expression (15:85) denoting the highest form of pardon
key_terms.العفو: Forgiveness, pardon — the act of letting go of an offense
key_terms.عتاب: Reproach, rebuke — blaming or reminding someone of their fault

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Rida interpret the Quranic verse about gracious forgiveness?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) interprets the Quranic verse 'So overlook with gracious forgiveness' (15:85) as meaning forgiveness without any reproach. This concise interpretation, part of a series of Quranic commentaries in the seventeenth assembly of al-Amali, reveals that true Islamic forgiveness goes beyond merely pardoning — it requires completely letting go of the offense without upbraiding or reminding the offender of their wrongdoing.
